company.name: HitPay
company.shortDescription: HitPay is a full stack payments infrastructure platform designed for growing businesses in APAC.
company.description: HitPay is a full stack payments infrastructure platform designed for growing businesses in APAC. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, HitPay unifies e-commerce, point of sale, and B2B payments into a single platform. The company is regulated in 6 APAC jurisdictions and backed by leading global investors, including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Global Founders Capital, and HOF Capital.

productsAndServices.description: A payment gateway and hosted checkout for accepting cards, bank transfers, QR payments, e-wallets, and buy-now-pay-later methods through websites, apps, and payment links.
productsAndServices.name: Online Payments

productsAndServices.description: Cloud-based POS software for processing in-person payments, managing products and inventory, tracking sales, and synchronizing activity across physical and online channels.
productsAndServices.name: Point of Sale

productsAndServices.description: A payment service for accepting international customers’ local cards, QR schemes, and e-wallets online, in stores, and through recurring billing workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Cross-Border Payments

productsAndServices.description: No-code, shareable payment pages that let businesses collect one-time or recurring payments through email, messaging apps, social media, QR codes, or other online channels.
productsAndServices.name: Payment Links

productsAndServices.description: Automated subscription and membership billing for setting payment plans, charging customers on scheduled cycles, tracking payment status, and retrying failed payments.
productsAndServices.name: Recurring Billing

productsAndServices.description: Digital invoicing software for creating branded invoices, accepting online payments, tracking balances, sending reminders, and supporting taxes, discounts, partial payments, and recurring invoices.
productsAndServices.name: Invoicing
